description: Capture a screenshot of a web page and return the image, so you can see how the page looks. Desktop, phone or tablet; full page or a single element. Cookie banners, ads and chat widgets are hidden. 2 credits.

clean.description: Hide ads, trackers and chat widgets (default true). Set false to capture the page exactly as served.

delay.description: Seconds to wait after loading, for animations or late content.

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the first screen. Lazy-loaded content is loaded first.

hide_selectors.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to hide before capturing, e.g. ".promo-bar,#newsletter".

selector.description: CSS selector of one element to capture instead of the page, e.g. "#pricing" or "header".

url.description: Full URL of the web page, including https://

wait_for_selector.description: Wait until this CSS selector appears before capturing, for single-page apps.

name: screenshot
title: Take a screenshot
